        text_1 = Text("I was added with Add!")
        text_2 = Text("Me too!")

        texts = VGroup(text_1, text_2, text_3).arrange(DOWN)
        rect = SurroundingRectangle(texts, buff=0.5)

        self.play(
            Create(rect, run_time=3.0),
            Succession(
                Wait(1.0),

                Add(text_2, text_3),

ThreeDScene.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects.doc: This method is used to prevent the rotation and movement of mobjects as the camera moves around. The mobject is essentially overlaid, and is not impacted by the camera's movement in any way.
